sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Sabrina Tavernisi.
sentences.zh: 我是来自《纽约时报》的萨布丽娜·塔韦尼西。

sentences.en: And I'm Michael Bavaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴瓦罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Today, two stories.
sentences.zh: 今天，有两个故事。

sentences.en: First, my colleague Pam Bellick on why any day now, a federal judge in Texas could issue an order to ban the pill used in more than half the abortions across the country.
sentences.zh: 首先，我的同事帕姆·贝利克将探讨为什么得克萨斯州的一名联邦法官随时可能发布命令，禁止在全国半数以上堕胎中使用的药物。

sentences.en: And Julian Barnes goes inside the Biden administration's plan to publicize secret intelligence to ensure that China never enters the war in Ukraine on behalf of Russia.
sentences.zh: 朱利安·巴恩斯则深入剖析了拜登政府公布秘密情报的计划，以确保中国绝不会代表俄罗斯介入乌克兰战争。

sentences.en: It's Wednesday, March 1St.
sentences.zh: 今天是3月1日，星期三。

sentences.en: All eyes are on the state of Texas, where a federal district judge's opinion is expected soon in a case that could impact reproductive rights again.
sentences.zh: 所有目光都聚焦在得克萨斯州，一起可能再次冲击生殖权利的案件预计很快会迎来联邦地区法官的裁决。

sentences.en: Here, a group of anti-abortion doctors and medical organizations are suing the FDA, challenging the approval of Mifeprex, generically known as Mifepristone,
sentences.zh: 在这里，一群反堕胎医生和医疗机构正在起诉美国食品药品监督管理局（FDA），对米非司酮（Mifeprex，通用名为Mifepristone）的批准提出质疑，

sentences.en: part of a two-drug regimen commonly used for abortions.
sentences.zh: 这是通常用于堕胎的两药联合方案的一部分。

sentences.en: The result, if you win, is that abortion access will be significantly limited.
sentences.zh: 如果你们赢了，结果将是堕胎渠道受到极大的限制。

sentences.en: Is that the goal of this lawsuit?
sentences.zh: 这就是这起诉讼的目的吗？

sentences.en: No, the goal of this lawsuit is to protect American women and girls from dangerous chemical abortion drugs.
sentences.zh: 不，这起诉讼的目的是保护美国妇女和女孩免受危险的化学流产药物的伤害。

sentences.en: This is essentially a backdoor national abortion ban.
sentences.zh: 这本质上是一项变相的全国堕胎禁令。

sentences.en: And what I mean by that is this affects states like California, New York, Illinois, Minnesota, Colorado that have taken...
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这会影响到加利福尼亚州、纽约州、伊利诺伊州、明尼苏达州、科罗拉多州等采取了……

sentences.en: When you allow mail-order abortion drugs, like the FDA has done, you get these dangerous chemical abortion drugs in the mail without ever seeing an abortionist even in person.
sentences.zh: 正如FDA所做的那样，当你允许邮购堕胎药时，人们甚至无需亲自去看堕胎医生，就能通过邮寄获得这些危险的化学流产药物。

sentences.en: No ultrasound, no protections.
sentences.zh: 没有B超，没有保障。

sentences.en: They're not going to stop until abortion is completely banned in the whole country, and being in a blue state is not going to save you.
sentences.zh: 在全国彻底禁绝堕胎之前，他们是不会罢休的，身处蓝州也救不了你。

sentences.en: So, Pam, tell me about this case.
sentences.zh: 那么，帕姆，跟我讲讲这个案子吧。

sentences.en: So this is a case that was filed in a federal court in Texas, and it was filed by a consortium of anti-abortion groups.
sentences.zh: 这个案子是在得克萨斯州的一个联邦法院提起的，原告是一个反堕胎团体联盟。

sentences.en: And basically, it wants the FDA to be ordered to revoke the approval of the two main drugs that are used for medication abortion in the United States.
sentences.zh: 基本上，它要求法院下令FDA撤销对美国药物流产所使用的两种主要药物的批准。

sentences.en: And remember, medication abortion has become an increasingly common method of abortion.
sentences.zh: 记住，药物流产已经成为一种越来越普遍的堕胎方法。

sentences.en: It's now used in more than half of abortions in the United States.
sentences.zh: 目前它已被用于美国半数以上的堕胎。

sentences.en: And that proportion is almost certainly growing since the Supreme Court overturned Roe v.
sentences.zh: 而且自从最高法院推翻罗诉韦德案以来，

sentences.en: Wade.
sentences.zh: 这一比例几乎可以肯定是呈上升趋势的。

sentences.en: And what's their argument?
sentences.zh: 他们的论点是什么？

sentences.en: So they spend a lot of time talking about the first drug that's used in this two-drug medication abortion regimen, and that's called mifepristone.
sentences.zh: 他们花了很多时间讨论这种两药药物流产方案中使用的第一种药物，也就是米非司酮。

sentences.en: And mifepristone was approved for abortion in 2000, so 23 years ago.
sentences.zh: 米非司酮是在2000年被批准用于堕胎的，也就是23年前。

sentences.en: And the main argument in this case is they are claiming that it should not have ever been approved for abortion.
sentences.zh: 本案的主要论点是，他们声称该药根本就不应该被批准用于堕胎。

sentences.en: They say that there were a bunch of procedural errors in the way that the FDA went about approving mifepristone.
sentences.zh: 他们声称FDA在批准米非司酮的过程中存在一堆程序错误。

sentences.en: They claim that it was initially approved under a regulation that was only supposed to be for illness, and they claim that pregnancy could not be considered an illness.
sentences.zh: 他们声称该药最初是根据一项只应适用于疾病的法规批准的，并声称怀孕不能被视为一种疾病。

sentences.en: And they're also claiming that this drug and the other drug, misoprostol, are unsafe.
sentences.zh: 他们还声称这种药以及另一种药米索前列醇是不安全的。

sentences.en: They say that women who take these drugs end up in the emergency room, hemorrhaging and with infections, and that it's not safe for the women to be using these drugs.
sentences.zh: 他们说服用这些药物的女性最终会大出血、感染并住进急诊室，女性使用这些药物并不安全。

sentences.en: And is any of that true?
sentences.zh: 这些说法有哪怕一点是真的吗？

sentences.en: I mean, as you've said, you know, these drugs have been on the market for over 20 years now.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，正如你所说，你知道，这些药物上市已经超过20年了。

sentences.en: So mainstream credible medical experts
sentences.zh: 因此，主流且可信的医学专家

sentences.en: would say that there really is no basis to the claims in this lawsuit.
sentences.zh: 会认为这起诉讼中的指控根本没有任何依据。

sentences.en: These drugs used for medication abortion are really very safe.
sentences.zh: 用于药物流产的这些药物其实非常安全。

sentences.en: 20 plus years of studies have shown that fewer than 1% of pregnant patients who take these drugs at the appropriate time end up with serious complications.
sentences.zh: 20多年的研究表明，在合适时间服用这些药物的孕产患者中，出现严重并发症的比例不到1%。

sentences.en: So, you know, there can be serious complications like hemorrhaging and infection, but they are very, very rare.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，可能会出现大出血和感染等严重的并发症，但它们非常非常罕见。

sentences.en: And many experts will point out that actually the process of going through a pregnancy has a much greater safety risk for a woman than taking these abortion medications.
sentences.zh: 许多专家会指出，实际上，经历怀孕过程对女性的安全风险要远大于服用这些流产药物。

sentences.en: So the safety arguments really have no real grounding to them.
sentences.zh: 因此，安全方面的论点完全站不住脚。

sentences.en: The procedural arguments also seem to be really without merit.
sentences.zh: 程序方面的论点似乎也同样毫无根据。

sentences.en: And one of the things that's very interesting, particularly about mifepristone, is that it was actually approved by the FDA and continues to be regulated by the FDA
sentences.zh: 一个非常有趣的情况是，特别是关于米非司酮，它实际上是由FDA批准的，并且一直受到FDA的监管，

sentences.en: in a very, very strict way, much more strict than most other drugs.
sentences.zh: 采用的是非常非常严格的方式，比大多数其他药物都要严格得多。

sentences.en: So it's actually somewhat ironic that there are claims that the FDA has been kind of lax here or has ignored evidence about mifepristone because, in fact,
sentences.zh: 因此，声称FDA在这里表现得有些松懈或忽视了有关米非司酮的证据，这其实有点讽刺，因为事实上，

sentences.en: it's kept a very, very tight lid on mifepristone and has carefully monitored it since it's been approved.
sentences.zh: 自该药获批以来，FDA对其进行了极其严格的管控和密切监测。

sentences.en: So this is kind of unheard of, right?
sentences.zh: 所以这简直闻所未闻，对吧？

sentences.en: What this group is asking.
sentences.zh: 这个团体的要求是。

sentences.en: Like, that a court would undo an FDA approval process, which is a scientific process that's taken years with many experts.
sentences.zh: 比如，法院竟然要推翻FDA的审批程序，这是一个历时多年、有众多专家参与的科学程序。

sentences.en: Like, what does a federal judge know about science and medicine?
sentences.zh: 一个联邦法官又懂什么科学和医学呢？

sentences.en: Yeah, you know, when this lawsuit was first filed in November, many legal experts thought that it would kind of die quickly and it just seemed like a very fringe kind of claim
sentences.zh: 是的，你知道，当这起诉讼在11月首次提起时，许多法律专家认为它很快就会不了了之，这看起来只是一种非常边缘化的诉求，

sentences.en: that had really no legal basis.
sentences.zh: 完全没有任何法律依据。

sentences.en: But it hasn't.
sentences.zh: 但它并没有消停。

sentences.en: You know, we're at the point where we're going to get at least an initial ruling in the case.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们现在已经走到了这一步，即将迎来该案的初步裁决。

sentences.en: And if the court were to rule in favor of the anti-abortion groups, it would apparently be the first time that a court has ordered the FDA to revoke a drug against the FDA's will.
sentences.zh: 如果法院做出有利于反堕胎团体的裁决，这将显然是法院历史上首次违背FDA的意愿下令其撤销一种药物。

sentences.en: And it would also have implications for, you know, really any other drug, potentially, vaccines or contraception or morning-after pills.
sentences.zh: 这也将对潜在的任何其他药物产生影响，你知道，比如疫苗、避孕药或事后避孕药。

sentences.en: This is the kind of thing that could set a precedent that could have very widespread implications.
sentences.zh: 这种事情可能会开创一个先例，并产生非常广泛的影响。

sentences.en: So how did this case get to this point?
sentences.zh: 那么这个案子是怎么走到这一步的呢？

sentences.en: It's very interesting.
sentences.zh: 这非常有趣。

sentences.en: This sort of umbrella group, this consortium that is suing is called the Alliance for Hippocratic Medicine.
sentences.zh: 提起诉讼的这个类似伞形组织的财团被称为希波克拉底医学联盟。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: It decided to incorporate a couple months after Roe v.
sentences.zh: 它决定在罗诉韦德案被推翻几个月后注册成立。

sentences.en: Wade was overturned.
sentences.zh: 他们决定在得克萨斯州阿马里洛注册成立。

sentences.en: And they decided to incorporate in Amarillo, Texas.
sentences.zh: 这些团体本身其实并不总部设在那里。

sentences.en: The groups themselves are not actually based there.
sentences.zh: 事实上，该财团在田纳西州有一个通信地址，但他们选择了阿马里洛。

sentences.en: In fact, the consortium has a mailing address in Tennessee, but they picked Amarillo.
sentences.zh: 这似乎要么是一个非凡的巧合，要么是一个精明的法律策略，因为整个阿马里洛地区只有一名联邦法官。

sentences.en: And that appears to be either a remarkable coincidence or a savvy legal strategy because only one federal judge covers the Amarillo region.
sentences.zh: 而他是一位非常保守的基督徒。

sentences.en: And he is a very conservative Christian.
sentences.zh: 他是被特朗普任命的。

sentences.en: He was appointed by Trump.
sentences.zh: 他的名字叫马修·卡兹马里克。

sentences.en: His name is Matthew Kaczmarek.
sentences.zh: 他过去曾为一家保守派法律团体工作过。

sentences.en: And he has, in the past, worked for a conservative legal group.
sentences.zh: 在被任命为法官之前，他还写过包含一些反堕胎情绪的文章。

sentences.en: He has also written, prior to his being appointed a judge, he has written articles that included some anti-abortion sentiments.
sentences.zh: 所以你的意思是，原告无论是因为巧合还是刻意为之，最终找到了一位可能非常同情他们立场的法官。

sentences.en: So essentially what you're saying is that the plaintiffs find themselves either by accident or very much on purpose before a judge who's probably pretty sympathetic to their cause.
sentences.zh: 原告确实表示他们并非在“挑选法官”。

sentences.en: The plaintiffs do say that they weren't judge shopping.
sentences.zh: 他们说他们位于阿马里洛是因为他们的一些成员住在那里，而且他们确实有一名在那里执业的医生原告。

sentences.en: They say they are located in Amarillo because some of their members live there and they do have one doctor who is also a plaintiff who practices there.
sentences.zh: 但我认为许多关注此案的法律专家觉得，他们之所以将目标锁定这个司法管辖区，是因为他们认为能在这里找到一位同情他们的法官。

sentences.en: But I think a lot of legal experts watching this case feel that they were targeting this jurisdiction because they thought they would find a sympathetic judge.
sentences.zh: 鉴于此，接下来可能会发生什么？

sentences.en: So given that, what's likely to happen?
sentences.zh: 让我们看看，现在是周二东部时间下午一点左右。

sentences.en: So let's see, it's about one o'clock Eastern time on Tuesday.
sentences.zh: 我一直在不断刷新页面，想看看法官是否已经做出裁决。

sentences.en: And I have been repeatedly refreshing my page to try to check and see if the judge has ruled yet.
sentences.zh: 他随时随地、每一分钟都可能做出裁决。

sentences.en: He could rule any day, any minute.
sentences.zh: 这将是一项初步裁决，基本上会命令FDA将第一种药物流产药物米非司酮撤出市场。

sentences.en: And this would be a preliminary ruling which would basically order the FDA to take mifepristone, this first medication abortion drug, off the market.
sentences.zh: 我认为鉴于这位法官的政治背景，这种可能性很大。

sentences.en: And I think that could be likely just given the political background of this judge.
sentences.zh: 而且由于它在联邦法院审理，这不仅适用于得克萨斯州的阿马里洛或得克萨斯州本身。

sentences.en: And because it is in a federal court, this would not just apply to Amarillo, Texas or to the state of Texas.
sentences.zh: 它将适用于整个国家。

sentences.en: It would apply to the entire country.
sentences.zh: 所以基本上，你将看到得克萨斯州一个城市的一名联邦法官，彻底颠覆了联邦政府对一种用于堕胎的药物长达20多年的批准。

sentences.en: So basically you'd have one federal judge in one city in Texas upending 20 plus years of federal approval of a drug used for abortion.
sentences.zh: 所以你认为堕胎权活动人士真正担心的事不仅很有可能发生，而且随时都可能发生。

sentences.en: So you think that the exact thing the abortion rights activists are really worried about is actually pretty likely and could happen any minute now.
sentences.zh: 是的，我的意思是，我认为这位法官以这种方式裁决绝对是非常有可能的。

sentences.en: Yeah, I mean, I think it's certainly quite possible that that is the way this judge will rule.
sentences.zh: 但目前尚不完全清楚这样的裁决是否真的会消除甚至限制药物流产的途径，至少短期内不会。

sentences.en: But it's not at all clear that such a ruling would actually eliminate or even limit access to medication abortion, at least not anytime soon.
sentences.zh: 请解释一下。

sentences.en: So explain that.
sentences.zh: 为什么不会？

sentences.en: Why not?
sentences.zh: 首先，FDA和代表FDA的司法部将倾尽全力应对此案，以对抗这项裁决，

sentences.en: Well, first of all, the FDA and the Department of Justice, which is representing the FDA, they are going to throw everything that they have at this case to try to fight the ruling
sentences.zh: 并力求在诉讼期间将其搁置，同时努力维护米非司酮的可及性。

sentences.en: and try to get it set aside while they're fighting the ruling and try to preserve access to Mifepristone.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们已经看到蓝州的联邦法院提起了多起诉讼，这些诉讼可能会促使其他联邦法官做出裁决，

sentences.en: And then separately, we are already seeing several lawsuits that have been filed in federal courts in blue states that could result in rulings, by other federal judges
sentences.zh: 基本上与这位得克萨斯州法官的言论相左。

sentences.en: that basically sort of contradict what this Texas judge might say.
sentences.zh: 因此，如果你最终遇到一个蓝州的法官说，你知道，你需要维护米非司酮的可及性，或者FDA批准米非司酮是正当的，

sentences.en: And so if you end up having a judge in a blue state saying, you know, you need to preserve access to Mifepristone or the FDA is justified in approving Mifepristone,
sentences.zh: 那么你就会遇到针锋相对的联邦法官，这最终将上诉到最高法院并在那里得到解决。

sentences.en: then you're going to have sort of dueling federal judges and that will go up to the Supreme Court and it will have to be resolved there.
sentences.zh: 最后，如果FDA在官司中落败，FDA拥有执法自由裁量权。

sentences.en: And then finally, if it turns out that the FDA loses this case, the FDA has enforcement discretion.
sentences.zh: 如果FDA认为某些药物是安全有效的，并且它显然认为这种药物是安全有效的，

sentences.en: It can decide in many cases that it just doesn't want to enforce or it doesn't have the resources to enforce certain regulations on drugs if it considers those drugs
sentences.zh: 它在许多情况下可以决定就是不予执行，或者没有资源去执行对这些药物的某些监管规定。

sentences.en: to be safe and effective and it obviously considers this drug to be safe and effective.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，FDA可以直接无视它？

sentences.en: So in other words, the FDA can just ignore it?
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为专家预计他们会认真探索无需执行它的方法。

sentences.en: Well, I think experts expect that they would seriously explore ways to not have to enforce it.
sentences.zh: 除此之外，堕胎领域的实际情况中还会有其他几个因素发挥作用，

sentences.en: And then there are a couple other things that will also likely kick in, you know, on the ground in the abortion world.
sentences.zh: 其一是，你知道，

sentences.en: One is that, you know,
sentences.zh: 我刚才说过米非司酮是药物流产中使用的两种药物的第一种。

sentences.en: I've said Mifepristone is the first of two drugs that is used in medication abortion.
sentences.zh: 第二种叫做米索前列醇。

sentences.en: The second one is called Misoprostol.
sentences.zh: 现在有许多医疗提供者正计划只为堕胎患者使用米索前列醇。

sentences.en: And there are many providers now that are making plans to use Misoprostol only for their abortion patients.
sentences.zh: 在许多国家，它通常在难以获得米非司酮的地方被单独使用。
